entities.summary: Bouchra Ijork is a Moroccan filmmaker, screenwriter, dramatist and actress. She studied dramatic arts in Morocco, graduating from the ISADAC in 1998. She then had a brief stint playing a few roles in theater and television. In 2003, she attended the summer university programme at La Fémis in Paris.
